tpsp.title: SP: token shard → All-Gather → real TP causal attention → Reduce-Scatter
tpsp.scope: A minimal two-head attention + output projection, not a complete DeepSeek layer. Norm, residual and MLP are omitted. X has four tokens, two hidden columns; each attention head has dimension one. Q=K=V=X by identity projection; causal attention; scale=1/sqrt(1)=1. Wo rows belong to the corresponding head/rank.

steps.description: rank0 owns tokens 0,1; rank1 owns tokens 2,3. Each token row retains both hidden columns.
Both ranks receive the full X, [4,2]. This is concatenation, not SUM.

steps.operation: Local head projection and causal attention
steps.description: rank0 computes Q/K/V from column 0 and head0; rank1 uses column 1 and head1. Each head attends to tokens at or before the query token; masked score entries are null and masked probabilities are zero.
A_r = head_output_r @ Wo_row_r. Both A0 and A1 are [4,2] partial sums computed from real attention; they are not fabricated attention outputs.
Y=A0+A1. The collective sums contributions and returns rows 0,1 to rank0 and rows 2,3 to rank1. Y shown in the diagram is the mathematical full result, not a required intermediate all-reduce.
Concatenate the two output token shards and compare with unsharded concat(head0,head1) @ Wo.

dpep.title: DP + EP：请求分开执行，MoE 专家跨这两张 GPU 共享
dpep.notice: 教学网络 Dense前层 → MoE → Dense后层；所有数字为可手算示例，非真实模型实测。两个 dense 层是普通线性层，不代表 Attention。

weight_layout.dense: [in,out]；行向量约定 Y=X@W，前后 dense 均无 bias、无额外激活
weight_layout.experts: 沿用原 EP 数据的 [out,in]；Linear=X@W.T+bias，再 ReLU

groups.note: 本配置 TP=PP=PCP=1，DP 与 EP 成员均为 GPU0/GPU1。vLLM 的 MoE EP 组在固定 PP stage 内覆盖 DP×PCP×TP；EP 不是额外乘出的设备维度。相同 rank 成员不意味着同一个通信器对象。
groups.dense_ownership: 两端完整复制 Wpre/Wpost；请求 A 的源 token 在 GPU0，请求 B 的源 token 在 GPU1。
groups.expert_ownership: 固定 linear placement，EPLB 关闭：E0/E1 完整参数在 GPU0；E2/E3 完整参数在 GPU1。每个专家矩阵未作 TP 切分。

moe.title: EP：同一MoE层内派发、专家计算、回源归并
moe.scope: EP=2, 4 experts, top-2, fixed placement, no EPLB; DeepEP LL weighting semantics
moe.teaching_notice: 全部数值与2维Linear+ReLU专家均为教学模型；不是Qwen/DeepSeek真实专家，也不是DeepEP支持2维hidden的硬件配置声明。
moe.weighting_notice: apply_router_weight_on_input=False。DeepEP LL将topk_weights传给combine，权重与归并在combine kernel内部完成；weighted_contributions只是等价算术分解。

steps.detail: GPU0 持有 A 的两行；GPU1 持有 B 的两行。这里从已得到的输入激活开始。

steps.detail: 两端读相同完整 Wpre，分别计算本地 X@Wpre，得到原 EP 算例的四个 token。

steps.title: 本地 Router 选择 top-2
steps.detail: 每个源 token 选择两个专家并保留对应 combine 权重；教学路由结果已固定。

steps.title: EP dispatch 到专家所有者
steps.detail: 激活与专家选择元数据按目的地派发；本地目的地留在本卡，跨卡目的地经 EP 通信，到达后才能读取。

steps.title: 各 GPU 执行所拥有的完整专家
steps.detail: E0/E1 在 GPU0，E2/E3 在 GPU1；每个专家对收到的 token 执行 ReLU(X@W.T+bias)，此处输出尚未乘路由权重。

steps.title: Combine 回源并加权求和
steps.detail: 专家结果回到 token 源端，combine 内部应用 top-2 权重并求和；A 恢复到 GPU0，B 恢复到 GPU1。

dptpp.title: DP2 + TP2 + PP2: two independent dense inference batches on 8 GPUs
dptpp.matrix_convention: X and hidden=[tokens,features]; W1/W2=[input_feature,output_feature]; stage=ReLU(X@W1)@W2; no bias; no activation after W2.

groups.note: Dense DP0 and DP1 each use an independent 4-rank distributed world. Physical GPU numbers 0..7 are teaching labels, not one shared 8-rank torch world. No cross-replica dense DP communicator is asserted here.

dptpp.rank_mapping: world_local_rank=pp_stage*2+tp_rank inside each independent DP world; physical_gpu=dp_rank*4+world_local_rank is only the teaching physical-device label.

steps.detail: A goes to DP0 (GPUs0..3), B goes to DP1 (GPUs4..7). Each replica has the same complete two-stage model collectively; no dense hidden aggregation across DP replicas.
Both TP ranks have the same stage input. W1 output features and matching W2 input rows are split 0,1 versus 2,3. Compute local Z, ReLU H, and partialY.
The two partialY matrices sum to full Y on both source TP ranks. A gives [[2,7],[1,2]]; B gives [[-2,13]].
With all_gather_group=TP and numel divisible by TPsize, each source TP rank sends its contiguous half of flattened replicated Y along its PP group. This is not always a token-axis partition.
Each destination TP rank receives its corresponding flattened slice, then the destination TP group all-gathers slices in TP-rank order and restores the original tensor shape.
Use reconstructed Y as stage1 input; split stage1 W1/W2 in the same feature convention, compute local partialY.
Each destination TP rank gets its replica final hidden. A=[[9,5],[3,1]]; B=[[13,17]].
Return final hidden independently for each DP request. No invented logits, sampling, cross-DP hidden merge, or training gradient All-Reduce.

boundaries: The matrices define a teaching dense two-stage MLP, not a real model layer. Source references support communication boundaries, not the teaching model dimensions.
TP shards weights/features within each stage; PP partitions the sequential stages; DP replicates this entire TPxPP topology for separate requests.
PP payloads show only one replicated dense hidden tensor. Real models may pass additional tensors such as residual, and actual structured metadata is omitted.
The flattened slice optimization shown requires numel divisible by TP size and a replicated source tensor. No SP is enabled; do not generalize it to token-sharded source tensors.
Request A has [2,2] hidden, so each PP slice happens to be one row. Request B has [1,2] hidden, so each PP slice is one scalar. Both reconstruct the full hidden before stage1 consumes it.

PP send submits communication; receiver must wait for receive and subsequent All-Gather completion before consuming the tensor. Diagram order expresses dependencies, not guaranteed global serialization.

Dense DP replicas each initialize an independent 4-rank TPxPP world in this source path. There are 8 physical GPUs total, but physical GPU4 has local distributed rank0 in DP1, not rank4 in one 8-rank world. Same (PP,TP) coordinates across replicas do not imply an actual dense DP communication group.
